caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden block with rounded edges and a hollowed-out cavity on one end, positioned toward the center of an off-white or beige background. Several metallic nails are partially spilling out from the hollowed cavity, with the nail heads visible and some of the nails overlapping each other as they extend downward in different directions. The wood has a light brown color with visible grain lines, and the nails are rendered in gray, giving them a metallic appearance. The drawing is centered, and near the bottom right, the name "WELLINGTON BLEWETT" is printed in uppercase black letters. The background is plain and unadorned, with no additional objects present.
title: Box for Nails and Pins
